purpose: Vanilla Schedule I scene source candidates discovered from the user-provided Daffy's Hills 1.2 DLL strings. Paths are lookup hypotheses and must be confirmed in the live scene.

sourceCandidates.role: Harbor Market visual shell only; no original scripts, colliders, stock, door, or property behavior copied
native bench visual; seat interaction intentionally not copied
native bus-stop visual; transport timetable not copied
native road-node hierarchy for road/nav survey
Docks region boundary and world hierarchy survey

implementationNotes: Source paths were recovered from strings in the supplied compiled DLL; this is not proof that every path resolves in the installed game version.
HarborlineNativeVisualReuse copies MeshFilter.sharedMesh, MeshRenderer.sharedMaterials and basic Light settings into new local GameObjects.
It does not copy MonoBehaviours, colliders, NPCEnterableBuilding, InteractableObject, DoorController, AvatarSeatSet or FishNet NetworkObjects.
Streetlights, promenade benches and a bus-stop visual are used with geometry fallback when no source exists.
Road-node hierarchy and position output are exported by NativeScenePrefabExporter for the next verified road-navigation implementation.
Harbor Market now attempts to reuse the render-only shell of the vanilla Docks clothing store. It is visual-only and has no cloned storefront interactions, inventory or Property registration.
NativeRoadGraphExporter traverses every child under Map/Pathfinding/RoadNodes and exports world/local transforms and component types to native-road-nodes.csv. It does not alter the A* graph.
